rules.title: Cancelled accounts cannot submit orders
rules.description: Accounts with status 'C' (Cancelled) are blocked from all order submissions. This is a hard block — no exceptions.

evidence.docQuote: Accounts with status **C** (Cancelled) are **rejected** for all order types.

rules.title: Suspended accounts are blocked from orders
rules.description: Accounts with status 'S' (Suspended) are blocked from all order submissions per standard policy.

evidence.docQuote: Accounts with status **S** (Suspended) are **rejected** for all order types.

rules.title: Suspended accounts may submit DISC orders
rules.description: Suspended accounts are blocked from all orders per spec v3.2, but ORDVAL.rpgle carves out an exception for DISC orders (ticket CS-4471). This exception exists in code but is completely undocumented — a legal requirement from 2010 class action settlement.

evidence.docQuote: No exceptions exist for suspended accounts under any order type.
evidence.contradictionNote: Code implements DISC exception (CS-4471) but spec doesn't mention it — 11 years out of sync

rules.title: Plan-7 legacy customers retain locked-in pricing
rules.description: Despite documentation stating legacy pricing was retired in 2012, Plan-7 customers MUST receive locked-in pricing per class action settlement 2009-CV-118. This rule exists in code comments only — completely absent from documentation.

evidence.contradictionNote: Code-only rule — no documentation to compare against. Extracted from pricing logic with class action reference in comments
